alert.subject: Execution Ledger: Drasi heartbeat missing
alert.bodyText: The drasi:heartbeat KV entry has expired — execution-ledger-drasi may be down. Check the Drasi container app and any batch windows or schedules that depend on reactive release.

data.description: Independent backstop for silent Drasi degradation — runs on the ordinary scheduler+worker path, not on Drasi itself, so it still fires when Drasi is fully down.
